stability_reading_of_record: conditional with minimum support: a pair or programme counts only when at least 3 of the arm's 5 runs rank or rate it; otherwise 'insufficient data', excluded from the mean. Thresholds use >=. Decided by Goulven on 2026-11-08. The conditional and literal readings are kept as an appendix.
scorer_consistency: discrimination recomputed from key-programme ranking positions equals the scorer's correct/eligible on all 15 records

of_record.reading: conditional, pairs ranked by at least 3 of 5 runs; others 'insufficient data', excluded

conditional.reading: share over the runs ranking both programmes, averaged over pairs ranked by at least one run

literal.reading: share over all 5 runs, averaged over all 10 key pairs (unranked pair = not following)

of_record.reading: conditional, programmes given a verdict by at least 3 of 5 runs; others 'insufficient data', excluded

conditional.reading: share over the runs giving a verdict for the programme, averaged over programmes given by at least one run

literal.reading: share over all 5 runs, averaged over all 5 key programmes (missing programme = not modal)
